notes.title: Yume No Office chapters 2 and 3 have gone into production.
notes.content:
With over 100 units in circulation, Chapters 2 and 3 are now entering production. We want to thank everyone for your reviews and the love you've shown throughout the creative process. Here’s what we have planned for this upcoming update (these features may change or increase, so this is just an estimate):

• 9 new expressions for the half-body sprites  
• 2 new outfits for the protagonists  
• 15 CG artworks  
• 25 new events  
• 2 new poses for each half-body sprite  
• At least 15 more backgrounds  
• 15 new special artworks  
• 15 new songs

All of this is planned for late 2025.

Additionally, we will be adding an extended demo that will be available to those who have the project on their Wishlist. There is no set date yet, but we hope to release it before the end of the year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120841/5065901c4892c9126d20fd0e9fd102e5eae383c4.png[/img]

notes.title: Yume No Office Core Gameplay Change
notes.content:
[b]Yume No Office 1.2.0 Update:
[/b]

In this version, major gameplay changes focus on streamlining the experience. The repetitive gameplay loop has been removed, allowing for a more narrative-driven approach. The Pong minigame now carries story significance, and the in-game calendar has been optimized for better event sequencing. Five additional mini-events have been added, and achievements will remain intact despite these changes. This will be the only major core gameplay change until the end of the game’s lifecycle, including Chapters 2 and 3.

[olist]
[*] Removed repetitive game loop.
[*] Increased narrative focus.
[*] Pong minigame has narrative weight.
[*] Optimized calendar.
[*] 5 new mini-events.
[*] Achievements unaffected by changes.
[/olist]

[u][b]We recommend starting a new game[/b][/u]

notes.title: Yume no Office - Chapter 1 - LAUNCH TODAY
notes.content:
After 2 years of work, Yume No Office Chapter 1 is released today. We have worked on an enormous amount of details to make this experience the best it can be. It has been thoroughly tested and polished to the utmost to avoid bugs.

If you happen to encounter any issues, please join our Discord server.

And even if you don't, we still invite you to join! We hope to create a community around this novel and to share even more games with you in the future.

Sincerely and with all our affection: K-bayashi
